title: OpenClaw is Hawt
content:
I posted this on Twitter. An old fashioned scoop let. Peter Steinberger the creator of product formally known as Clawdbot is one hot commodity in Silly Over AI Valley.

The word around Silicon Valley is that everyone from Meta to OpenAI to xAI wants a piece of OpenClaw and its creator. Zuck and Sam might even have met with him. Ideally given its open source ethos he should take a cue from WordPress and build this one for the future for everyone, and go work with/at a company that would believe in that open source ideology.

via Twitter

There were lines outside the door and people were clamoring to get into the 1st ClawCon. OpenClaw has caught the imagination of those who tinker, build and experiment.

Feb 4, 2026. San Francisco
author: Om Malik
